notes.title: V0.2.0 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
"Dear fellow gamers, we’ve recently rolled out some updates to the game content.

The details of the Version 0.2.0 update are as follows:
[olist]
Changed all instances of the character name "Me" to "Andade";

Updated the 'Thanks for Playing' page, adding new community information.
[/olist]
If you enjoy our game, we’d love for you to join our community to stay updated on the latest news! Thank you once again for your support and feedback!"

Let me know if you'd like any adjustments!
Once again, thank you all for your support and feedback! 🎮

notes.title: Bug fixes and updates for demos
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for the feedback from the players!
The following are the fixes and optimizations made based on feedback:
1. CG unlock issue ✔  Fixed
2. The last CG image has an unlocked bug ✔  Fixed
3. Incorrect spelling of "Dededi" in Chinese text ✔  Corrected
4. A small amount of garbled text ✔  Fixed
5. Multi language text playback speed text bug ✔ Fixed
Regarding language support:
-Added AI translation language, supporting Korean and Spanish.
Regarding the thank you trial:
-We have created a QQ: 1033176415 communication group and welcome players to join and share their gaming experiences together!
Other optimizations:
-We have comprehensively optimized the above issues to ensure a better gaming experience.
Thank you again for your support and feedback! 🎮
